## Professional Summary

Kawin Prabhakaran is an Artificial Intelligence and Data Science graduate currently working as an AI/ML Engineer at Teceze Ltd.

His professional focus is on developing practical AI-powered applications, integrating Large Language Models into software systems, building Retrieval-Augmented Generation solutions, and experimenting with Model Context Protocol integrations.

His experience includes:

- Developing RAG-based knowledge assistants for retrieving information from Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and technical manuals.
- Integrating Large Language Models into application workflows.
- Implementing prompt engineering, contextual grounding, and response validation.
- Working with out-of-scope query detection and fallback mechanisms.
- Experimenting with MCP-based integrations for self-hosted project management platforms.
- Developing Python-based backend applications and REST API integrations.
- Building internal LMS automation portals for candidate registration, assessment assignment, and evaluation management.
- Developing AI-powered applications involving NLP, machine learning, and contextual information processing.
- Performing industrial data analysis, predictive modelling, and business dashboard development.

His primary professional interests include Enterprise Generative AI, LLM Engineering, RAG Systems, Agentic AI, MCP Integrations, Python Backend Development, and Intelligent Workflow Automation.

## Featured Engineering Projects

### 1. Enterprise RAG Knowledge Assistant

**Category:** Generative AI | Enterprise AI | Retrieval-Augmented Generation

Developed a Retrieval-Augmented Generation application that enables site engineers to ask natural-language questions about Standard Operating Procedures and technical manuals.

The application uses document-based contextual retrieval to provide relevant information from technical documentation.

Key engineering areas:

- Retrieval-Augmented Generation.
- Document-Based Knowledge Retrieval.
- LLM Integration.
- Prompt Engineering.
- Contextual Grounding.
- Response Validation.
- Out-of-Scope Query Detection.
- Fallback Mechanisms.
- NeMo Guardrails.

The project focuses on making enterprise technical documentation more accessible through conversational AI.

### 2. MCP-Based Plane Integration Harness

**Category:** Agentic AI | Model Context Protocol | AI Integration

Developed an experimental integration harness for a self-hosted Plane project management environment to explore AI-driven interactions through the Model Context Protocol.

The objective is to simplify project management interactions and explore tool-based AI integration.

Key engineering areas:

- Model Context Protocol (MCP).
- Python MCP SDK.
- MCP Client-Server Communication.
- Tool Integration.
- REST API Integration.
- Asynchronous Python.
- Project Management Automation.

This is an experimental integration initiative and should not be represented as a fully production-deployed autonomous agent.

### 3. LMS Integration and Candidate Assessment Portal

**Category:** Backend Engineering | Workflow Automation | Application Integration

Developed an internal portal that integrates candidate registration and assessment workflows with a Learning Management System (LMS).

Key functionalities:

- Candidate form collection.
- Automated user registration.
- LMS account creation.
- User profile management.
- Assessment assignment.
- Evaluation result retrieval.
- Assessment result display.

Key engineering areas:

- Python Backend Development.
- REST API Integration.
- Application Workflow Automation.
- Database Management.
- LMS Integration.
